question: Which NFL legend just slapped a YouTuber on live TV?
story: Tom Brady slapped Logan Paul across the face in front of a live crowd, and now the two might actually settle it inside a wrestling ring. According to TMZ, the seven time Super Bowl winner is reportedly in talks with WWE, which would set up an actual match against Logan Paul. Here is how this even started. Back in February, Paul reportedly told Brady at a Fanatics event that his wrestling career made him just as athletic as an NFL player. Brady did not let that go. He roasted Paul at a flag football draft for bringing up his high school football stats. Then it escalated fast. At Fanatics Fest in New York, Brady walked on stage and slapped Paul clean across the face. Fans are still arguing over whether that slap was staged. Brady reportedly said he had been waiting for someone to come up with the right storyline. Looks like he found it.
